label: positive

blockers.detail: M adds gas codeview state (--gcodeview, gas/codeview.c/h); codeview data is built during assembly and must be released by codeview_finish() (declared in gas/codeview.h). The old fuzz_as never calls codeview_finish() nor the gas output_file_close()/free_notes() teardown, so a run on M crashes (SIGSEGV). H adds codeview_finish() plus output_file_close()/free_notes() to the init/cleanup flow.

evidence: H patch (OSS-Fuzz #9400) adds codeview_finish() (teardown declared by M in gas/codeview.h) plus output_file_close()/free_notes() to fuzz_as init/cleanup
input/source is the complete binutils 2.40 release tree (c203a2e3a814782ea3a83a6eb60c3a58e6725eba), which contains M; change.diff is M^1->M
baseline build/run used binutils 2.39 release (749caa2cc374b62d79113a17c988c72bebe6cf0b), a pre-M ancestor; old fuzz_as exit 0 on seed.s

rationale.zh: binutils M (`gas: Add --gcodeview option`) 引入 codeview 相关状态和销毁流程；旧 fuzz_as 缺少 codeview_finish/输出清理等新生命周期调用，在 M 上运行会 SIGSEGV；H 按新流程补齐初始化和销毁。
rationale.en: binutils M ('gas: Add --gcodeview option') adds codeview state/teardown; the old fuzz_as lacks codeview_finish/output cleanup and crashes (SIGSEGV) at M. H adds the new init/cleanup flow.
